message: Dependabot proposes uv updates after 1 day (default-days: 1 in .github/dependabot.yml), but uv waits 3 days (exclude-newer: "3 days" in uv.toml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than uv accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 3 days, or run depcurfew apply
